id.description: Globally unique identifier for this delegation.

ifsId.description: IFS system identifier for this Delegation.

entityType.description: Entity category for this object, normally Delegation.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this delegation record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this delegation record was last updated.

permissionId.description: Identifier of the permission delegated from the delegator to the delegate.

permission.description: Permission entity represented by permissionId when expanded by an implementation.

delegatorRef.description: Reference to the role or member delegating the permission.

delegateRef.description: Reference to the role or member receiving the delegated permission.

revokedAt.description: Timestamp when this delegation was revoked, if applicable.

expiresAt.description: Optional timestamp after which this delegation no longer applies.
